objective: Retain curved-board strength while keeping the fresh-plane learning that solved the reported L6 diagnostic. Isolate curve output retention from completed-Q policy targets.

priorEvidence.interpretation: Small development sample, not proof of significant curve regression. Retention is a hypothesis. Previous games are development knowledge, never new independent evidence.

data.partition: Reuse pinned origin-game partitions. No previous development, pilot, independent or reported game added to learning.
data.sampling: Every board1/9. Each plane70% legacy+30% fresh; curves100% legacy. Identical input rows, common validation targets and weights across all arms. Only eligible curved training policy changes for CompletedQ.
data.curveTargetSource: Existing noise-free4096 teacher root traces on each exact old root; teacher model8e5b41e3974c..., not the deployed model. Keep source model/wasm hashes per row. This is target construction, not fresh on-policy curve collection.
data.splitCompression: gzip; splitSha256 is the decompressed original

curveAnchor.teacher: Frozen deployed checkpoint; cache predictions on training curved roots only, no validation fitting.
curveAnchor.domain: sphere and torus only; plane loss/gradients receive zero additional term.
curveAnchor.loss: lambda * curveMask * [KL(frozen policy || current legal policy) + KL(frozen WDL || current WDL) + 0.5*MSE(frozen normalized score,current score) + 0.5*maskedMeanNodeKL(frozen ownership||current ownership)]
curveAnchor.eligibility: Apply on all normal curved training rows, independently of ordinary policy eligibility. No anchor term in common checkpoint selection. Keep teacher tensors frozen.

completedQ.prior: Stored raw legal NN prior targetSearch.prior from the same clean4096 search, not the prior-mixed training target.
completedQ.q: targetSearch.diagnostics.rootQ, already root player perspective; visited iff rawVisits>0.
completedQ.mixedValue: N=sum(childVisits); qbar=sum_{visited}(max(prior,float32tiny)*Q)/sum_{visited}max(prior,float32tiny); vmix=(vNN+N*qbar)/(1+N), or vNN if N=0.
completedQ.transform: sigma(Qcomplete)=0.1*(50+max(childVisits))*Qcomplete. rescale_values=False because WDL values already have fixed[-1,1] scale; this option is supported by the reference. No coefficient/temperature sweep.
completedQ.policy: softmax(log(rawPrior)+sigma(Qcomplete)) on legal actions only; illegal and padding have zero mass. No25% prior or2% uniform mixture added afterward.
completedQ.unaffected: Plane policy, all validationPolicy fields, features, actions, outcome/score/ownership, splits and row order remain identical. Certified-loss/ineligible rows retain original policy.
completedQ.diagnostics: Record entropy, support, probability on originally zero-policy hands, unvisited legal mass, scale and source hashes. Distinguish raw-zero/eliminated from proven bad. No practical policy-improvement guarantee under approximate Q.

training.selection: Lowest unchanged common validation loss, including epoch0; ties prefer earlier. No anchor loss or arm-specific target in common checkpoint selection.
training.resumes: All arms start from deployed baseline, not previous failed NewData weights.

preflight.control: Integrity only; epoch0 remains valid. Candidate arms require gates.
checks: Identical rows, roots, outcome labels, split and common validation digest
Frozen teacher and plane isolation; anchor weight0 matches base loss
Completed-Q hand examples, zero-visit and masking/permutation behaviour
120905 inference parameters and CPU/WebGPU golden/actual Worker checks

development.candidateRule: All gates and candidate total score strictly exceeds Control and candidate curve score >= Control curve score. Control always measured if any candidate reaches this stage. Eligible candidates only.
development.selection: At most1 candidate with highest overall score; ties prefer higher curve score, then CurveGuard over CompletedQ. Freeze chosen checkpoint before matches.

independent.unit: colour-swapped opening pair, stratified by board

matches.capped: Keep and score actual Game area, include in CI, report count. No outcome-dependent replacements.
matches.seed: FNV1a32(phaseSeed|board|pair|ply); identical legal opening and per-ply seed for both colours and arms
matches.audit: Replay every move; verify actors,seeds,root visit counters,exact scores and pair aggregation.

latency.fixtures: 27 roots from first Control development pair0/colour1 at floor(N/4),floor(N/2),floor(3N/4), clamped to last nonterminal saved ply; predefined public reported/pass/proof stress fixtures. Freeze concrete files before timing.
latency.equalTime: If strength and fixed-visit latency pass, use baseline-only calibration on the frozen roots to fix per-board time budgets before any candidate timed comparison; report separately. No claim of phone speed without real measurement.

diagnostics.reportedGame: Public L6 fixture only. Not training or selection input; log rank/visits/choice after model freeze.
diagnostics.priorIndependent: Never reopen old unconsumed holdouts or train on previous match outcomes.

stopping: No hyperparameter sweep or extra replicas in this round. Failed preflight/development/independent/latency closes the round with all negative results archived. No substitute candidate, extra games or repeated independent test after failure. No push/deployment.
